question: Who assumed charge as the new Vice Chief of the Indian Navy on 31 July 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SN Ghormade**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Vice Admiral SN Ghormade assumed charge as the Vice Chief of the Indian Navy on 31 July 2021.

• He succeeded Vice Admiral G Ashok Kumar in this role.

• Prior to this appointment, SN Ghormade held the position of Deputy Chief of Naval Staff at Naval Headquarters.

• Vice Admiral SN Ghormade has a distinguished career in the Indian Navy with several key appointments to his credit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Vice Admiral Karambir Singh**

• Karambir Singh served as the 24th Chief of the Naval Staff (CNS) of the Indian Navy from May 31, 2019, to November 30, 2021.

• He succeeded Admiral Sunil Lanba and was the first helicopter pilot to become the CNS.

• Karambir Singh has had a distinguished career with numerous operational and staff appointments.

• **Vice Admiral Ravneet Singh**

• Ravneet Singh is a senior officer in the Indian Navy who has held various significant positions, including the Flag Officer Commanding-in-Chief (FOC-in-C) of the Eastern Naval Command.

• He has a rich operational experience and has commanded several frontline ships.

• **Vice Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi**

• Dinesh K Tripathi is a senior officer of the Indian Navy who has held several key appointments, including the Director General of Naval Operations.

• He has extensive experience in both operational and administrative roles within the Navy.
